caption:
A SpaceX rocket just launched holiday treats to the Space Station, but what if you tried baking actual cookies in zero gravity? Without gravity, hot air doesn't rise, so heat circulates differently, and crumbs float everywhere into sensitive equipment. Instead of a flat, crispy circle, your cookie would bake into a strange, floating sphere of dough. Would you eat a zero-gravity space cookie? Follow for more what-ifs.

Based on today's news: NASA, SpaceX rocket launch in Florida to send holiday cookies to space
